title: [开源]OxideTerm： Rust+GPUI，让终端飞起来！
content: OxideTerm is an open-source, cross-platform terminal and SSH client written in Rust using the GPUI framework. It supports protocols such as SSH, SFTP, Mosh, RDP, and VNC. Recent updates focus on performance, significantly improving throughput and reducing memory consumption for large logs. Features include native plugins, local semantic coloring, a draggable SFTP sidebar, X11 forwarding, and an MCP interface for AI integration. Licensed under GPL-3.0, OxideTerm is free, requires no account, and does not collect telemetry data, targeting users seeking a lightweight alternative to established terminals like WindTerm.

content: In the AI Agent Coding era, developer-AI conversation sessions are becoming more valuable than source code. While sessions act as critical "meta-assets," they contain sensitive data such as API keys, local paths, and proprietary information. Therefore, publicly releasing them requires rigorous sanitization. Future standards should distinguish between raw and anonymized sessions, linking them to Git commits, preserving prompt and tool interactions, and enabling partial replay. However, replaying a session does not guarantee reproducible development, as results depend on model versions, context, and execution environments.

title: 提供一些关于美区 App Store 订阅 Claude 的信息
content: Anthropic permanently links Apple IDs to specific Claude accounts for App Store subscriptions. If an original Claude account is suspended, the associated Apple ID cannot purchase new Claude Pro subscriptions for any other account. This restriction causes errors even when using new Claude accounts. Users report being unable to resubscribe after account bans, with Apple Support confirming the permanent backend association.
